slices.focus: Eric and Danielle pay to install a backyard shed to relieve the storage overflow that had been consuming closets and Maya's play space, accepting the financial hit as a practical correction to household crowding rather than continuing to normalize a bad setup.
slices.summary: A backyard shed purchase relieves months of storage overflow that had been shrinking Maya's play space and consuming closets, with Eric and Danielle agreeing on zones, a donation pass, and a no-new-projects spending rule afterward.
open_loops: Full inventory vs light zones approach not yet decided
Whether the garage becomes usable space or just cleaner storage
decisions: Eric and Danielle paid to have a backyard shed installed so overflow household storage would stop taking over the garage
Paying for the shed delayed any real savings rebuild and kept Eric feeling financially narrow after other recent repair
